
  bench
    Run and inspect benchmarks

    Runs a workload against an embedded engine, a spawned daemon, or a remote
    target, then renders the result. `bench show`, `bench compare`, and `bench
    plot` read runs already written to disk.

  COMMANDS
    run       [flags]     Measure a workload against a queue
    show      <run-dir>   Render a saved run
    compare   <dir>...    Diff two or more runs
    plot      <run-dir>   Chart a run's series

  USAGE
    bench <command> [flags]
